M-BEHAVIOR-UPDATER.Purpose: Global tick loop: drive subscribed behaviors each frame through a weak-reference list, with throttling support for time-sliced work.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: BehaviorUpdater: subscription list of weak references, per-frame tick.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Throttler: rate limiting helper. Ownership accounting — owned by M-BEHAVIOR-REGISTRY.

Requirements.REQ-001: A behavior whose owner was collected stops being ticked without manual unregistration per S-RUNTIME-PLATFORM.REQ-002.
Requirements.REQ-002: Tick order follows subscription order and is stable frame to frame per SS-RUNTIME-SERVICES.REQ-002.

Inputs.IN-001: deltaTime: float — frame delta from the root.

Outputs.OUT-001: drives Behavior.Update on every live subscribed behavior.

SideEffects.EFF-001: May drop dead weak references from the subscription list during tick.
